title: Prompted text tool-calling mode for assistant agent models
observed_behavior: The assistant agent loop sends AgentModelRequest.Tools and ToolChoice auto to the configured AgentModelClient.
The native OpenAIAgentClient serializes those fields as OpenAI-compatible tools/tool_choice and expects content or native message.tool_calls in the response.
Gemma via the operator's local llama.cpp/lemmy OpenAI-compatible endpoint does not emit native OpenAI function-calling tool_calls and can return an empty assistant message.
intended_behavior: Native OpenAI-compatible tool-calling remains the default behavior.
Operators can set assistant.agentic.tool_mode to prompted for OpenAI-compatible models that follow text instructions but do not implement native function-calling.

Prompted mode sends no native tools or tool_choice fields, injects the available tool catalog and strict tool-call format into the prompt, renders prior assistant tool calls and tool observations as text, and parses a fenced tool_call JSON block into Bahia's canonical AgentModelResponse.ToolCalls.

excluded: Live validation against the operator's LAN-only Gemma endpoint
